sources.guide: WHO/UNICEF 2021, Indicators for assessing infant and young child feeding practices, ISBN 9789240018389
sources.project_rules: docs/CONTRACT.md: age uses days/30.4375; reason patterns and 7/14-day windows are project heuristics, not WHO diagnostic criteria.
sources.age_caveat: WHO 2021 formula uses 183 <= days <730; current project schema uses 6 <= days/30.4375 <24 (183..730 inclusive). Preserve project validation; not exact WHO survey age eligibility.
sources.missing_milk: WHO 2021 calculation guidance scores missing feed-frequency answers as zero. Project optional milk_feed_count=None is zero for MMF; never infer dairy checkbox from this count.
